digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions Gerrit Verified CI workflow
propositions: Ubuntu Verified jobs consume 30.2 runner-minutes per run (py3.11 615s, py3.12 634s, py3.13 563s) and represent material org-wide queue contention despite macOS being the completion critical path
Bridge cadence test repeated YAML parsing 1,440 times (7.653s of 7.925s per test) due to schedule loading inside the exhaustive minute comprehension, costing ~5.7 runner-minutes per Verified run

Real-Pandoc Pandoc corpus tests execute all 232+ eligible units for cardinality/secrets/tables assertions but exhaustively invoke legacy subprocess oracle (3,421 total invocations) to prove equivalence, consuming 18.80s of 45.60s combined corpus/hardening wall

Static golden Pandoc fixtures with committed binary hashes plus a small representative live contract can replace the full corpus repetition in Verified while moving complete real-Pandoc replay to the weekly/manual External Integration workflow, subject to ADR 0095 supersession

AST provenance fixture setup (46–51 seconds per Ubuntu cell) repeatedly discovers caller/parent relationships via 9.54M ast.walk calls instead of reusing indices, adding 48s to every Ubuntu cell without changing the preserved 24 assertion tuples

Complexity-lock policy runs the same OS/Python-invariant evaluation in all four matrix cells (52–55s Ubuntu, 45s macOS) rather than once in the lint job, costing ~2.57 runner-minutes per run without changing coverage
